data.name: Jabalah
data.gender_notes: Jabalah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘jabal’ which means ‘mountain’. In Islamic history, Jabalah bin Al-Ahad was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for his courage and bravery. The name Jabalah carries the meaning “Mountain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jabalah usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jabalah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabalah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: جبالة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جبالة هي اسم علم مؤنث يعود إلى الجذر العربي جبَل، ويتعلق بالقوة والnobility، وله تاريخ استخدام طويل في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث أُطلِق على نساء قويات ونبيلات، وله أهمية روحية في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: جبالہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: جبالہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو جبَل سے ماخوذ ہے، جو طاقت اور شرافت کی象征 ہے، اور اس کا استعمال برصغیر پاک و ہند کی مسلم ثقافت میں بکثرت ہوا ہے، اور یہ نام روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: ज़बाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़बाला एक अरबी नाम है जो ज़बَل से व्युत्पन्न है, जो शक्ति और श्रेष्ठता का प्रतीक है, और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में व्यापक रूप से हुआ है, और यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व का वाहक है

data.cultural_impact: The name Jabalah signifies strength, courage, and resilience, not just in terms of physical traits, but also in one's spirit and character. In Islamic culture, Jabalah is remembered as a hero and a devoted follower of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name holds a great deal of respect and inspiration for those who bear it, emphasizing the importance of bravery and loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Jabalah represents the idea of lifting oneself up to higher spiritual heights, just as a mountain rises above the surrounding land. It can be seen as a reminder to strive for personal growth and to seek enlightenment, elevating one's faith and deepening one's connection with God. Additionally, Jabalah represents steadfastness, particularly in the face of adversity, as it takes considerable strength to climb mountains. This aspect of the name encourages individuals to be resilient in their faith, and to remain steadfast in their commitment to following God's guidance.
